Why two

Two stages. Two formulas.

Fresh work needs sealing. Settling work needs conditioning. The balm is too heavy for the second stage; the cream too light for the first.

Step one · Days 1–14

Restore Balm

Richer · Sealing · Protective

A concentrated balm that lays down a protective layer and holds moisture in while the work closes over. Thin layer, clean dry skin, morning and night.

Step two · The months after

Recovery Cream

Calm · Condition · Refresh

A lighter daily cream that sinks in fast to hydrate and soothe while the work settles. The stage most people skip. Don't.

Heavy, detailed work uses both, layered. Fifteen years in the chair says one product can't do it. That is why they're sealed together.

The founder

Our aim

Built on discipline. Driven by purpose.

“TEL isn't a brand you buy once. It's a standard you choose.”

Most things are made to be good enough. TEL started on the opposite belief: that good enough is a decision, and so is everything better.

It starts with aftercare, because looking after the work is the work. It grows the way it began — chapter by chapter, each one earned before it's named.

The hero, swapped

Same words. Same place. v5's picture.

The v6 hero was the sealed set on black — a catalogue shot: honest, but black-on-black with nothing pulling the eye. The v5 scene render puts the box on stone under a gold ring; it reads as a brand before it reads as a product, and the eyebrow / Earned. Not given. / gold button sit low-left over the plinth exactly as they did on the v5 phone.

  • Uploaded to Files, not left as a theme assetShopify now serves responsive copies (800 → 1200 px) with fetchpriority=high, so the largest paint on a phone is a ~120 KB image instead of the 220 KB original.
  • Mobile focal: top · Desktop focal: centreOn a phone the whole render fits at 700 px. On a 16:9 desktop the portrait crops to the box and the top of the plinth — I added a desktop focal control to the hero section (v6 had it hard-coded).
  • Placement untouchedBottom 32 px on mobile, 72 px on desktop, gradient veil at 86%, slow 18-second push-in. All v5 values, all still adjustable in the editor.
Option, one click each: if you'd rather the landscape shoot on desktop and the scene only on phones, set Image to the sealed-set r1 shot and Mobile image to the scene. Both controls exist in the hero section.

The audit · applied in v6.1

Ten changes, two to the copy.

Eight are structural: image, rhythm, repetition, and two things that were quietly broken. Two are the copy tweaks you approved on 7 September.

  • Hero → v5 scene, v5 writing and placement doneAbove. Files upload, responsive srcset, mobile focal top, desktop focal centre.
  • Announcement bar split into two messages doneThe single 73-character line wrapped to two rows on every phone under 430 px. Now "CHAPTER ONE · NOW OPEN · FIVE HUNDRED SETS" and "FREE SHIPPING AUSTRALIA-WIDE · SHIPS FROM SURFERS PARADISE", rotating every five seconds.
  • Spec strip back to three facts done"Free shipping" was on the page four times — bar, strip, price ledger, footer icons. Three facts hold one line on desktop and two balanced lines on a phone.
  • Background rhythm: strict alternation donev6 had the founder and the chapter meter both on the lifted tone, back to back. Now product · steps · proof · reviews · chair · founder · aim · chapter · newsletter — no two neighbours share a tone.
  • "Our aim" band added after the founder donePure type: the page's own mark line as the pull quote, two lines from the page, one outline button to /pages/about. It breaks the run of image bands before the 500 numeral and gives the brand's why a place on the home page for the first time.
  • Page template: duplicate title removed, wider column doneOur Aim, The Founder, Trusted By and The Healing Guide all carry their own h1 inside your HTML. The default page template was printing the page title above them as a second centred heading, inside an extra-small column. Title off, column large — all four pages, one change. Plain-text pages (Shipping & Returns, and Privacy when it goes live) keep their title through a separate page.page.json with a narrow column; FAQs, which has its own h1, moved to the default template.
  • Desktop focal control on the hero doneEditor setting: upper third / upper-centre (v6's hard-coded value) / centre / lower-centre.
  • Proof heading → "Tested. Not claimed." done · your callYour line now leads the sub: "We live and breathe tattoos — we know chemistry. Both ingredient lists published in full…" The heading joins the page's other short declaratives and holds one line on a phone.
  • Chair button → "The artists" done · your callSame link (/pages/trusted-by). "From the chair" is already the band's eyebrow, so the button takes the noun instead.
  • Live numbers wired and checked doneMeter and "sets remaining" read the variant's inventory (450 today). Reviews ledger reads Judge.me's product metafields (6 reviews, 5.0 of 5) — it hides itself if the count is ever zero.
Your call · not changed

Three things I'd consider.

  • Founder band length optionThree paragraphs is the longest block on the phone. The middle one ("Aftercare is usually made at a distance…") is the one to cut; the Founder page carries it.
  • Chapter body vs meter minor"Five hundred sets" appears in the numeral, the heading and the body. Fine now; when stock drops below 100 the body could switch to "Fewer than a hundred left."
  • Klaviyo list still double opt-in carriedUnchanged from the last audit — a "Join" that sends a confirm-email halves the list. Flip it to single opt-in before Thursday.
The Aim part

Sorted in two places.

On the home page: the new band (gold rule on its left edge in the v6.1 phone). Order is founder → aim → 500 → first access, so the story runs who · why · now · next.

On the page itself: /pages/about now renders without the theme's second "Our Aim" heading and in a large column. Your HTML is untouched; nothing on the live site changed — the fix lives in v6.1's page template, so it applies the moment v6.1 is published.

Copy check on the page: it's strong and consistent with the home page ("Built on discipline. Driven by purpose. Proven under the gun.", seventeen years, the standard, where it's heading). The one line I'd tighten is the close — "Welcome to the elite standard." sits on the card, the Trusted By lede and here; on this page "Choose the standard." would land harder and set up the two buttons.

Housekeeping

Before you publish.

  • Look at the desktop hero oncePortrait scene on a wide screen crops to the box and plinth. If you'd rather the landscape shoot there, it's the two image pickers in the hero section.
  • Delete the v5 draft theme when v6.1 is approvedIt's superseded, and it carries seven zz-render-tmp-*.jpg assets I parked there to pull your shoot images into this render (the API can't delete files, only add them).
  • Delete sections/tel-spec-strip-probe.liquidAlready neutralised in v6 (no preset, never shows in the section picker); one click in the code editor removes it for good.
  • Publish v6.1, not v6Then rename it to whatever you call the live theme. The home page, page template and header are the only files that differ from v6.
